751-1115-6006.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4770-4885-6006-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

141-1854-2034.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1854-2034.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

728-1270-5551.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
728-1270-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat from step 4.

277-3129-4094-4365-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-3129-4094-4365-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

4823-4872-7370.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Timeless Witness.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Timeless Witness from exile to the battlefield.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

862-1003-1927-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-1003-1927-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

955-3259-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
955-3259-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
955-3259-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

1322-2034-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1362-1479-6528.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

779-2178-3394-4050-7409.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four land cards in your graveyard.
779-2178-3394-4050-7409.description:
Activate Lluwen by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}{B/G}, tapping it and discarding Dakmor Salvage, creating a 1/1 Wurm creature token for each land card in your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Wurms, adding {2}{B/G}{B/G}{B/G}.
When the Wurms die, Weatherlight Compleated and Lluwen trigger five times each.
Resolve all Lluwen triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the first Weatherlight Compleated trigger, instead choosing to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Weatherlight Compleated triggers, drawing that many cards.
Repeat.
779-2178-3394-4050-7409.notes: As you mill cards, inevitably more lands will end up in your graveyard, meaning you'll make more tokens over time.

4131-7282-7343.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith.
Activate the Basalt Monolith token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate the Basalt Monolith token's second ability by paying {2} due to Mutagen Man, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1018-3617-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Skullwinder and exiling Ephemerate.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1806-2060-5902-6797-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2440-4720-6737-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Barret triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2440-4720-6737-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7330.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mikey & Mona.
When Mikey & Mona dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mikey & Mona enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

803-2034-2366-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
803-2034-2366-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-1496-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1496-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2919-2999-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2919-2999-3490.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1987-2556-4276-6991.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2556-4276-6991.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Mnemonic Wall.
When Donnie & April and Mnemonic Wall enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2556-4276-6991.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

5276-5332-6524-6797.description:
Cast All-Out Assault by paying {2}{R}{W}{B}.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your extra combat phase. All-Out Assault triggers, untapping each creature you control.
Declare Carmen as an attacker, triggering its second ability, returning Leonin Relic-Warder form your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling All-Out Assault.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability and Carmen's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, returning All-Out Assault from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

643-4929-5365-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
643-4929-5365-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Cryptic Trilobite for additional mana.

2058-2073-4779.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Flayer Husk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Flayer Husk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Flayer Husk to it.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Flayer Husk.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Byrke, Long Ear of the Law

2011-2060-5854.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
Crystalline Crawler does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2011-2060-5854.description:
Declare Crystalline Crawler and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Byrke's second ability triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If Crystalline Crawler has at least six +1/+1 counters on it, this combo nets infinite +1/+1 counter doubling.
You may also attack with one or more Warriors each combat phase to gain 1/1 Warrior creature tokens from Najeela.

969-3259-4191-5022.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a nontoken creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-4191-5022.description:
Declare Treasury Thrull and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Treasury Thrull triggers, returning a creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1242-2092-2335-4289.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 4 or greater.
1242-2092-2335-4289.description:
Activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron by paying {R}{G}, giving all other creatures you control +1/+1, trample and haste until end of turn.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch and Barrenton Medic by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch and Barrenton Medic's second abilities by putting a -1/-1 counter on them, untapping them.
Repeat.

1235-4719-5184-5195.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, targeting Anarchist.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of Anarchist with haste.
When the Anarchist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Twinflame to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

1933-2506-4191.description:
Cast Aether Adept without paying its mana cost.
Aether Adept enters the battlefield, targeting itself.
Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of Aether Adept.
Token copy of Aether Adept enters the battlefield, returning original Aether Adept to hand.
Resolve the original Aether Adept triggers, fails to resolve due to having no legal targets.
Repeat.

3277-4305-4377.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Izzet Chronarch.
3277-4305-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {6}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Izzet Chronarch.
Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Repeat.
